HomePage.aboutText1: At Haleon, I work with SAP data for supply-chain and logistics needs, organise BI team work, support project delivery and deliver training. I also help teams beyond my core remit with reporting, investigation and knowledge sharing.
HomePage.aboutText2: At Carlsberg Shared Services, my Operational Excellence work involved examining business processes, identifying bottlenecks and supporting process improvements. Earlier, as Marketing Manager for the Polish market at Bostik, I learned to view technology through business priorities, customers and commercial decisions. I have completed Scrum Master and Product Owner courses delivered by Scrum Inc. and Coaching Essentials as part of Haleon’s managerial development path.

projects.label: Selected work
projects.subtitle: Ideas put into practice

ev_assist.title: EV Assist
ev_assist.description: A web application that helps electric-vehicle drivers plan charging needs for a journey.
ev_assist.detail: The project combines route planning, vehicle data and charging calculations in a clear interface that can also work as a Progressive Web App.

fairpact.title: FairPact
fairpact.description: A tool designed to help users identify potentially unfair clauses in contracts.
fairpact.detail: The application combines document processing, OCR and language analysis to make contract review easier to navigate.
